evidence: loam-app ships no sign-up, sign-in, or password surface anywhere (index.html has no auth screens; store.js state has no account fields).

loam-api: identity is a client-minted pseudonymous device id sent as the x-device-id header (loam-app/store.js ensureDeviceId, crypto.randomUUID); no user table exists — the server keeps only an in-memory per-device daily counter (loam-api/app/main.py _daily defaultdict).
loam-app package.json dependencies are @capacitor/haptics, @capacitor/status-bar, @capacitor/keyboard, @capacitor/local-notifications — no analytics or tracking SDK.
loam-api/app/main.py has no analytics, no request-body logging, and no persistence of content; it meters requests in memory per pseudonymous device id and forwards to Anthropic.
No advertising SDK is present in loam-app or loam-api (package.json / pyproject dependencies).
The app renders no ad surface; monetization is a planned subscription only (loam-app/HANDOFF.md pricing law), never advertising.
